decision: On 2026-10-01 agalwood explicitly authorized publishing v9.0.2-motrix.3 in response to the exact-scope question disclosing the three secret-free pre-sign integration fixes and all 42 residual Action advisories (1 Critical, 18 High, 19 Medium, 4 Low), with validity only through 2026-10-15 UTC. This is a new single-version exception bound to this exact release tag, source lock, every workflow byte, supporting assessment, complete same-day audit report and official full-SHA Action references. Formal .2 run 36819481774 failed closed after all six candidate and four independent builds; its approval is not reused and both prior annotated tags remain immutable. The .3 scope uses O_BINARY in protected low-level regular-file readers, a deterministic linker ad-hoc baseline on both macOS architectures, and bounded read-only source-built x64 NASM evidence in exact input/rebuild byte comparison and final verification. That evidence is not executed by signers or distributed in payload archives. Native Windows reader regressions and macOS ad-hoc CI gates are required. BUILD_REVISION changes, but locked source archives/URLs, toolchains, official Action commits and all inventoried advisories are unchanged. Audit 36807648066 is the same-day complete inventory; no vulnerability is claimed fixed or wholly unreachable, including cache service/extraction risks before validation and signature type-binding risk. Publication remains conditional on all required exact-commit CI checks, file/race/size/hash guards, independent clean rebuilds, Developer ID signing/notarization, Ed25519 authentication, independent final verification, Immutable Releases and protected-Environment confirmations. This limited decision grants no Environment approval, no exception for another tag or changed scope/new advisories, and no publication after the deadline.
